items.question: Do you only use AI, or is there human creative direction?
items.answer: Human directors lead narrative, brand alignment, and approvals. AI accelerates variants, edits, and iteration—but never replaces creative judgment.

items.question: What formats can you deliver?
items.answer: Horizontal long-form for websites and YouTube, vertical/reels for social, square for feeds, and invitation-friendly cuts with captions—plus derivative thumbnails when needed.

items.question: Can you help with SEO for video?
items.answer: Yes—titles, descriptions, chapters, transcripts, and pairing videos with indexed landing pages so discovery stays coherent.

items.question: How fast can we ship?
items.answer: Timelines depend on scope and approvals. Lighter social batches move fastest; corporate narratives may require stakeholder review cycles—we quote timelines after the brief.

items.question: Do you produce invitation-only videos?
items.answer: Absolutely—see our dedicated invitation page for wedding, anniversary, and celebration-focused storytelling.

items.question: What do you need from us to start?
items.answer: Brand references (if corporate), event details (if invitations), desired placements, key dates, and any must-include messaging—we guide the rest.

contentSections.title: Why corporate AI video matters now
paragraphs: Buyers binge video before they ever talk to sales. A concise vision film, crisp demo, or HR narrative reduces friction and lifts trust—especially when every placement (site hero, LinkedIn, paid social) needs the right aspect ratio and pacing.

AI-assisted workflows mean more thoughtful iterations: alternate hooks for ads, trimmed chapters for executives, and caption-first edits for silent autoplay feeds—all without blowing the production calendar.

contentSections.title: Formats we tailor for enterprise use
paragraphs: Homepage hero narratives, annual kickoff films, category explainers, onboarding micro-learning, compliance-light walkthroughs (subject to your policies), and evergreen social proof loops.
Every deliverable is packaged with naming clarity so marketing ops can trace experiments and route files to agencies without confusion.

contentSections.title: SEO and discovery alignment
paragraphs: Publishing corporate videos alongside optimized landing pages helps intent-driven searches connect to proof. We coordinate titles, meta descriptions, transcripts, and embedded players so technical SEO and content SEO stay aligned.
If you host on YouTube or Vimeo, we advise chapters and descriptions that reflect how prospects actually search—not generic filler.

items.question: Can we match our existing brand guidelines?
items.answer: Yes—fonts, color cues, motion rules, and approval workflows can mirror your brand system; we document guardrails before editing begins.

items.question: Do you handle sensitive internal messaging?
items.answer: We follow mutually agreed confidentiality practices and can align with your legal/comms review cadence—limits depend on scope and jurisdiction.

items.question: How do we reuse assets across campaigns?
items.answer: We plan square, vertical, and landscape masters up front, plus shorter hooks so paid teams can rotate creatives without re-cutting from scratch.

contentSections.title: Invitation videos guests actually open
paragraphs: Static cards get lost in chats; short invitation films create anticipation and make logistics memorable—especially when couples or hosts want emotional tone, not template slideshows.
AI-assisted editing helps iterate on pacing, music beds, and scene order quickly while keeping your voice central.

contentSections.title: Formats for every screen
paragraphs: We export portrait-first clips for phones, cinematic wides for banquet intros, and neutral masters you can archive forever.
Need QR-ready snippets or teaser countdowns? We structure filenames so planners and vendors stay coordinated.

contentSections.title: SEO when invitations live online
paragraphs: Many couples publish invitation films on private sites or password pages—when public teasers exist, we align titles and descriptions with how guests search (venue city, family names, date).
Our goal is tasteful discoverability without compromising privacy—scope depends on what you choose to publish.

items.question: Can we include religious or cultural elements?
items.answer: Yes—share references, readings, or rituals you want reflected and we will honor pacing and symbolism thoughtfully.

items.question: What assets should we provide?
items.answer: Photos, short phone clips, venue references, names/date copy, music preferences, and any must-have wording—we guide shot lists even if you only have casual footage.

items.question: How private is the process?
items.answer: We treat milestone content discreetly; distribution choices stay yours—private links, downloads only, or selective public teasers.
